Vanilla Milkshake
By: Andie Mitchell
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 6:49am

Ingredients




1 quart vanilla ice cream
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 cup milk
1 cup half-and-half

Preparation

1 Place the ice cream and vanilla extract in a blender. While the motor is running, slowly add the milk and half-and-half. Blend until thoroughly combined. Pour into an ice cream parlor glass and serve.
